channel.title: Stargate Korea
channel.description: Plan your first Seoul trip with free itineraries, practical travel essentials and a custom digital guide enquiry. Independent Korea travel advice from Seoul.

item.title: Where to Stay for Your First Seoul Trip: Choose the Area First
item.description: Choose a base around your interests, your airport journey and the daily trips you actually want to make.

item.title: Before You Book Seoul Activities: Six Details to Check
item.description: A class, pass or attraction ticket should fit your route. Check the small details before you pay.

item.title: What Is the Suneung? Korea's College Entrance Exam Explained
item.description: Korea's college entrance exam is on Thursday, November 19, 2026. Here is what the day changes for anyone living, studying or traveling in the country, and where those rules come from.

item.title: How to Get Your Residence Card (ARC) in Korea: Step-by-Step Guide for Students
item.description: Staying in Korea for more than 90 days? You must register as a foreign resident within 90 days of arrival. Here is what to bring, how to book on HiKorea, what it costs and what to do after the card arrives.

item.title: Your First Week in Korea as an International Student: A Practical Checklist
item.description: Phone, transport card, residence registration, bank account, health insurance — the order you do things in during your first week matters. Here is the sequence that saves the most time.

item.title: Getting Around Seoul with a T-money Card
item.description: One card covers the subway, buses and many taxis. How to buy it, top it up, transfer for free and avoid the most common mistakes.

item.title: Seoul Neighborhoods Where International Students Actually Live
item.description: Sinchon, Hongdae, Anam, Hoegi and the area around SNU — what each neighborhood is like, which universities are nearby and what kind of housing to expect.
